svg.text: A. Step & Trajectory Uncertainty Estimators
Quantifying epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty before tool execution
1. Value-Token Log-Probability Score (Zero Extra Passes)
0 ms overhead
Masks out JSON boilerplate keys; scores only argument value tokens V(a_t):
u_val(a_t) = -min_{j in V(a_t)} log P_θ(y_j | y_<j, τ_1:t-1)
Catches guessed SKU IDs, uncertain price bounds & ambiguous enum slots
2. Action-Space Semantic Entropy (K = 5 Rollouts)
K=5 samples
Groups K sampled tool calls into canonical equivalence classes C_1..C_M:
SE(x, h_t) = - sum_{m=1..M} P(C_m | x, h_t) * log P(C_m | x, h_t)
Invariant to surface wording; high SE means agent is split across tools
3. Platt-Scaled Confidence Fusion (ECE: 0.184 -> 0.023)
AUROC = 0.89
Combines value-token logprob, top-1 CLIP retrieval cosine, and slot coverage:
C_hat(t) = σ( w_1 * l_min(a_t) + w_2 * cos_top1(o_t) + w_3 * margin_12 + b )
Trained via logistic regression on held-out trajectory success labels
B. Selective Routing & Abstention Policy in "Aria"
Turning calibrated confidence C_hat(t) into risk-bounded agent actions
Zone 1 · High Confidence (C_hat >= 0.82): Execute
74% of turns
• All required fashion slots resolved; CLIP top-1 cosine >= 0.78
• Action: Dispatch catalog_search immediately & render outfit cards
Zone 2 · Ambiguous Slot (0.45 <= C_hat < 0.82): Clarify
19% of turns
• High entropy on 1-2 specific slots (e.g., "formal dress" lacks budget/length)
• Action: Ask 1 targeted slot question + show 3 diverse visual anchors
• Prevents 0-hit over-filtering while keeping user engaged in flow
Zone 3 · High Risk (C_hat < 0.45): Safe Abstain
7% of turns
• Out-of-catalog request, policy dispute, or tool failure after 1 retry
• Action: Explicit abstention ("I cannot verify wash-care for SKU #412")
• Routes account/refund disputes to human support with structured summary
-> Cuts hallucinated policy promises by 91% at 93% task coverage
